sn1.36:4.1: The Burmese and Sri Lankan editions indicate that another devatā recites these verses, but the Thai edition doesn’t.
sn1.36:6.4: Aside from the final line, these last two verses are identical with Dhp 26–27. Here the final line reads, pappoti paramaṁ sukhaṁ, “attains the foremost ease,” while in Dhp 27 it reads, pappoti vipulaṁ sukhaṁ, “attains an abundance of ease.”
